task: Remove the pooled-mode script tool-call bridge wiring added in sub-task 1 and re-implement the bridge against BatchJobRunner's Kubernetes Job model, adding a new concurrency hook for side-channel polling alongside the currently fully-sequential job wait.

key_reasoning.reason: Spans BatchJobRunner (needs a genuinely new concurrency-hook abstraction — no such hook exists today), execute_workspace_script_tool.py (remove pooled branch, add jobs-mode bridge wiring), code_executor_tool.py (remove pod-lock/channel branch in _run_locked), and session_manager.py (remove the dead clamp) — 4 components across the Kubernetes execution and service-dispatch layers, with shared utilities (KubernetesClientManager, ExecRunner protocol, SandboxSessionManager's lock machinery which is also used by plain non-bridge pooled execution) involved throughout.

No precedent exists anywhere in this codebase for 'poll a side channel while a separate blocking wait proceeds' — BatchJobRunner.run() is strictly sequential on one thread across steps 5-12. The redesign also surfaces an unreconciled activeDeadlineSeconds-vs-tool-calling-timeout mismatch (30s execution_timeout default vs 120s tool-calling default) and must be proven safe against concurrent execs into the same pod.

The removal side is precisely enumerated (five call sites named exactly), but the addition side is explicitly undesigned: the concurrency interleaving mechanism, how activeDeadlineSeconds should size against the tool-calling limit, and how to disentangle bridge-only removal from SandboxSessionManager's continued use by plain (non-bridge) pooled execution are all open design decisions the technical analysis defers to Stage 3.

Estimated ~9-11 modified files (batch_job_runner.py, execute_workspace_script_tool.py, code_executor_tool.py, session_manager.py, customer_config_declarations.py description text, README.md, plus test_batch_job_runner.py, test_sandbox_dispatch.py, test_execute_workspace_script_tool.py) across 3-4 directories (code_executor/, workspace/, service/, tests/), with likely 1 new test file for a fake/threaded Job-lifecycle double since no existing fixture models this interleaving.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: touches core shared utilities — BatchJobRunner and SandboxSessionManager's pod-lock machinery are also used by plain (non-bridge) pooled code execution, so removal must be scoped carefully rather than deleted wholesale.
